actions.findings: The governance module enforces mechanical constraints that prevent arbitrary model-authored self-modification. [source-70c4dff141dd489d]
actions.limitations: The reliance on externalized constraints prevents the model from internalizing self-correction mechanics, limiting adaptability to novel governance failure modes.

actions.reason: Synthesizing evidence regarding assumption testing and governance checks.
actions.summary: By integrating the governance module's immutability as a fixed constraint, WAKE identifies its own boundary conditions as testable assumptions. Governance stability is maintained through the verifiable rejection of model-authored proposal transitions.
actions.title: Systematic Assumption Testing in Self-Correcting Models

actions.summary: Accountability is enforced via strict bifurcation of inquiry (model-driven) and governance (state-committed). This design prevents models from subverting the research record by ensuring that only valid, rule-compliant transitions are committed to durable history.
actions.title: Mechanical Accountability in WAKE Architecture
